package.name: Built-In Preference Packs
package.description: Preference Packs included with the FreeCAD distribution

preferencepack.name: FreeCAD Classic
preferencepack.description: Removes stylesheets, and applies the classic purple/gray background. Resets all colors to default

preferencepack.name: BruceWorx
preferencepack.description: Apple-clean light theme, millimetre units, Fusion-like navigation (Revit style: middle-mouse pan, Shift+middle orbit), PartDesign startup, and the PartDesign / Assembly / Sketcher / Part / TechDraw workbench set. Applying it snapshots current preferences. Apply the BruceWorx Off pack to restore them.

preferencepack.name: BruceWorx Dark
preferencepack.description: Same BruceWorx preferences as the light pack, with the dark stylesheet tokens and a dark viewport. Does not replace the snapshot taken by the first BruceWorx apply.

preferencepack.name: BruceWorx Off
preferencepack.description: Turns BruceWorx off and restores the preferences saved before it was applied. Stock FreeCAD defaults return for any key that was not set before.
